title: Universal Type-I Primitive Equation / Constitutive Kernel
purpose: Factor the 411-archetype × 60-field Type-I matrix into 20 reusable equation/state kernels so exact component instances can be stacked in 2D/3D/4D and numerical engineering inferences are produced only from attributable source/measured inputs.

inference_classes.NUMERIC_IF: all required inputs attributable + model/regime valid
inference_classes.SYMBOLIC: equation known but one or more required inputs unresolved
inference_classes.HOLD: model/regime, directional compatibility, process damage, safety/authority or evidence unresolved

kernels.law: k≈EA/L; δ≈FL^3/(3EI) only for stated cantilever assumptions; ΔL=αLΔT; m=ρV
kernels.inputs: E,G,ν,ρ,α; A,L,I; joints/boundaries; loads; T; mass/inertia
kernels.outputs: stiffness; deflection; stress/strain; thermal drift; modal candidates
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF geometry/material/joints/boundaries are attributable and assumptions pass; else SYMBOLIC/HOLD
kernels.example: PMU-CAND-001 frame candidate remains source-only; precision datums require measured finish/alignment.

kernels.models: DC conduction; contact; distributed parasitic RLC
kernels.law: R=ρL/A or Rs·L/W; P=I²R=V²/R
kernels.inputs: ρ or Rs; thickness; L,W,A; contacts; T; f/environment where consequential
kernels.outputs: R; voltage drop; Joule loss; current density; first-order thermal load
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF cured/source electrical property + actual geometry/contact state are bound; RF requires distributed model
kernels.example: LOCTITE ECI 1010 source candidate ≈7 mΩ/sq at 25 µm; coupon result unmeasured.

kernels.models: electrostatics; leakage; dielectric loss; field stress
kernels.law: C/A≈ε0εr/d; E≈V/d local ideal baseline
kernels.outputs: capacitance baseline; E-field baseline; leakage/loss only with source/process data
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF material/process/environment and geometry are bound; voltage/breakdown authority separate
kernels.example: Kapton HN 50 µm, εr≈3.4 @1 kHz → ideal C/A≈0.6020848 pF/mm²; 25 µm → ≈1.2041695 pF/mm².

kernels.law: R≈ρL/A or Rs·L/W; P=I²R=V²/R; τ≈RθCθ when lumped valid
kernels.outputs: R; power; heat-flux/temperature-rise estimate; thermal time constant candidate
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF electrical/thermal properties and boundaries bound
kernels.example: E3D Revo candidate: 24 V, 40 W, ~14.4 Ω initial at 23 °C; subsystem candidate only.

kernels.law: C≈ε0εrA/d ideal parallel plate; U=½CV²; Xc=1/(2πfC)
kernels.outputs: C; stored energy at declared benign V; reactance; field baseline
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF exact dielectric/electrode geometry and state bound; voltage/breakdown rating separate
kernels.example: CGXI-P2-C-001 Kapton HN 25 µm candidate → ideal C/A≈1.2041695 pF/mm² before fringe/loss/leakage/interface corrections.

kernels.law: L≈μN²A/l only when geometry/regime supports it; U=½LI²; Q≈ωL/Rseries
kernels.outputs: L; DCR; Q candidate; field/flux; self-resonance only with parasitics
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF geometry/material/frequency bound and approximation valid; otherwise field solve
kernels.example: PKP243D08B2 source motor winding: 10 mH/phase, 5.4 Ω/phase; not a printed-coil result.

kernels.law: λ≈c/(f√εeff) where valid; Γ=(ZL−Z0)/(ZL+Z0); field solve by geometry
kernels.outputs: Z0/impedance; phase; S-parameters; coupling/radiation candidates
kernels.gate: NUMERIC_IF band, ports, material models and boundaries declared; passive measurement first
kernels.example: CGXI-P3-LOOP-001 remains passive-band/use-case unresolved; no biological/natural-frequency target.

kernels.law: U=½CV² only electrostatic; electrochemical capacity/OCV/impedance require chemistry-specific model
kernels.outputs: energy/capacity; ESR/impedance; power/thermal estimate within validated model
kernels.gate: mechanism-specific; never infer battery behavior from void/carbon/geometry alone
kernels.example: CGA-C-006 EDLC remains chemistry/process gated.

kernels.models: ray; Fresnel/Jones; transfer matrix; wave optics
kernels.law: OPL=nL; φ=2πnL/λ; Snell n1sinθ1=n2sinθ2 where valid
kernels.outputs: phase; path; reflection/transmission/polarization/coupling candidates
kernels.gate: select geometric/wave model by scale/coherence; exact materials/source required
kernels.example: OSIRE E3635 is a seed RGB emitter candidate; integration ≠ local LED fabrication.

kernels.law: y=H(x,state,t)+bias+noise; S=∂y/∂x from source/calibration
kernels.outputs: measurand estimate; sensitivity; uncertainty; bandwidth where source-bound
kernels.gate: numeric use requires traceable calibration/source characterization
kernels.example: Renishaw TONiC family candidate has source-bound accuracy/resolution; exact scale/interface open.

kernels.law: τ=Jα+τload+τloss; τ≈KtI and back-EMF≈Keω only when source model applies
kernels.outputs: torque/force; acceleration/speed trajectory; power/loss/thermal candidates
kernels.gate: numeric selection requires complete axis envelope + torque-speed/transmission + thermal limits
kernels.example: PKP243D08B2: 0.35 N·m hold, 0.85 A/phase; not yet approved Printer-μ axis.

kernels.models: continuity; pressure-flow; species transport; hydraulic RLC
kernels.law: fully-developed laminar circular tube only: ΔP=8μLQ/(πr⁴); regime check mandatory
kernels.outputs: pressure drop; flow; residence/transport candidates; hydraulic impedance
kernels.gate: never apply laminar law outside assumptions; pressure/vacuum/reactive service separately gated
kernels.example: Vacuum is an environment state, not damping by definition.

kernels.models: conduction; lumped thermal RC; convection/radiation when bound
kernels.law: Rθ≈L/(kA) for 1D conduction; Cθ=ρcpV; τ≈RθCθ; Prad=εσA(T⁴−Tenv⁴) where valid
kernels.outputs: Rθ; thermal mass; time constant; heat flow/temperature candidates
kernels.gate: numeric only with boundary/interface/contact state and applicable regime
kernels.example: Per-layer thermal budget becomes numeric only after exact material/process stack and interfaces bind.

kernels.models: vendor compact/device model; timing/state machine; power/thermal
kernels.law: exact device/source model; no geometry-only transistor/semiconductor inference
kernels.outputs: timing/power/I/O/thermal integration candidates within source model
kernels.gate: insert-seed unless semiconductor process separately qualified
kernels.example: Pico 2/RP2350 is C1 prototype compute candidate; NUCLEO-G474RE is source-bound C0 prototyping candidate; neither is safety certification.

kernels.models: switched state-space; conduction/switching loss; parasitic RLC; control
kernels.law: P=VI; η=Pout/Pin; topology-specific ripple/loss only with exact switch/L/C/control models
kernels.outputs: conversion ratio; ripple; losses; thermal/control candidates
kernels.gate: exact topology/components/operating point required; protection separate
kernels.example: TMC2209 is a stepper-driver candidate, not a universal certified power stage.

kernels.models: deterministic monitored state machine + source-rated protection
kernels.law: trip/interlock/state-transition logic; thresholds only from exact source/system risk design
kernels.outputs: allowed/blocked state; diagnostic coverage only with applicable evidence
kernels.gate: cannot infer PL/SIL/category from component presence
kernels.falsifier: fault injection fails to reach/hold declared safe state
kernels.example: Pilz PNOZ X3 774310 is exact safe-state relay candidate, not complete C0 controller/safety case.

kernels.law: J≈−D∇c under Fickian assumptions; seal/contact mechanics source-bound
kernels.outputs: flux/leak candidate; barrier lifetime only with aging model; compliance/stress candidates
kernels.gate: hermeticity never inferred from geometry alone
kernels.example: Encapsulation is preservation only when chemistry/process is source-qualified.

kernels.law: clearance=allocated geometry−required envelope; tolerance stack by stated method
kernels.outputs: access clearance; assembly/disassembly feasibility; service-cycle risk candidates
kernels.gate: must preserve replaceability/readback without damaging adjacent qualified layers
kernels.falsifier: service mock-up cannot remove/replace/recalibrate within envelope
kernels.example: Service/access is a first-class volumetric void/keepout, not unused space.

kernels.law: Snapshot→Hash→Handshake→Execute/Test→Readback→Receipt→Reviewed Promotion
kernels.outputs: identity resolution; lineage; change/receipt state; no physical-property inference
kernels.gate: identity does not create capability/certification/execution/release authority
kernels.example: SH01-ID-A is first passive identity/readback route; physical execution separately gated.

kernels.models: mass transport; equilibrium; kinetics; charge transfer; thermal
kernels.law: Fick transport; Nernst equilibrium; Butler–Volmer kinetics only in validated regimes
kernels.outputs: flux/equilibrium potential/current-density/heat candidates only when model inputs valid
kernels.gate: chemistry/process-specific; reactive/electrochemical work separately qualified
kernels.example: rPET coupon is passive material qualification; no conductive-carbon/graphene conversion by classification alone.

kapton_HN_25um.evidence: CGXI-P2-C-001 instance-candidate geometry inference; lots/process/measurement unresolved

boundaries: no inferred voltage/breakdown/lifetime/certification from capacitance geometry
no chemical/electrochemical model outside declared chemistry/regime
no compiler output grants physical execution or release authority
